title: Converact v1 product contract
intent: Provide a model-agnostic contract, evidence, and convergence control plane for autonomous software engineering agents.
constraints: CLI and MCP adapters share the same Core semantics.
Changing contract or implementation state invalidates stale evidence.
Acceptance is blocked when MUST requirements are not satisfied.
nonGoals: Providing production deployment or sandbox orchestration in v1.

requirements.statement: A change cannot be accepted unless all MUST requirements have fresh passing evidence.
Any coding agent with shell access can use the CLI without MCP support.

checks.description: CLI syntax and version command pass.
